requirements:
Implement an in-memory key-value store in Rust as a SINGLE source file that compiles with `rustc --edition 2024`, using std only. Output ONLY the Rust source code inside ```rust fences. Do not include inner attributes (`#![...]`) or inner documentation (`//!`).

Expose `pub struct Store` with private implementation fields. All listed types and methods must be public. Keys and values are exact, case-sensitive UTF-8 strings; empty strings are valid keys and values. Strings passed by reference must be copied into owned storage. There is one visible value per key. A set replaces the previous value of that key. A get returns an owned clone, never a borrowed value. Deleting a missing key is harmless and returns false; deleting a present key returns true. count(value) returns the number of visible keys whose value exactly equals value, not a number of distinct values. No iteration order is exposed. new creates an empty, independent store.

Exact public API (inherent methods on Store):
- `pub fn new() -> Self`
- `pub fn set(&mut self, key: &str, value: &str)`
- `pub fn get(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String>`
- `pub fn delete(&mut self, key: &str) -> bool`
- `pub fn count(&self, value: &str) -> usize`
